pre_slice_publication: Committed and pushed a65c4a4 (native flight deck, transactional RayScene recovery, reviewed unified scene pass) to origin/feat/render-pipeline-optimizations at the user's request before this next slice. Author Mar2ianen, no rewritten history or laptop push.
scope: Manual pre-exposed RGBA16Float scene -> per-channel Reinhard -> SDR/sRGB -> display-referred egui/FastNavball. Reuses existing graphics hdr/exposure requests and existing scene pipelines/lighting. Not a complete native renderer, legacy tonemapper match, auto exposure, bloom, HDR-monitor output or temporal AA.
hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Linux, Vulkan / radv / Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1
settings: RequestedGraphics.renderer.hdr -> active adapter RGBA16Float render/sample usage capability -> ResolvedGraphicsSettings.hdr. False/known unsupported -> direct LDR, zero extra persistent target bytes and no display pass. Unknown pre-init/legacy capability retains request; native resolves before construction. Manual EV clamps to [-16,32], invalid ->13; actual native auto exposure/bloom application is explicitly false even if shared settings request true. No new environment-variable graphics toggles.
representation: Optional 8 bytes per physical pixel float color target, reusing scene depth. Existing terrain/mesh/sky shaders apply exposure once, display uses exact-pixel textureLoad and Reinhard x/(1+x). Hardware sRGB attachment transfer or explicit equivalent on unorm SDR output, never both. Target/bind replace on valid size change, pipelines remain; invalid resize leaves existing resources intact. No per-frame uniform, host image or readback.
error_boundary: Finite normal half-float rounding about <=2^-11 relative before mapping, underflow near zero and saturation beyond 65504 are limitations. Combined finite-pattern storage/operator/sRGB/8-bit comparison pinned within one output code per channel, not a complete physical/perceptual envelope or approximation bound for atmosphere/ocean. Negative/NaN components are contained to black by the display math; positive overflow clamps to finite half-float maximum.
